requirements.name: Any page of the service requires the user to be signed in

scenarios.name: Opening the dashboard unauthenticated requires signing in first

tests.test: lands on the sign in page when opening the notification dashboard
allows signing into the notification dashboard

scenarios.name: Opening a page deeper in an in-progress journey unauthenticated requires signing in first

tests.test: lands on the sign in page when opening a page further in the journey
allows signing into a page further in the journey

requirements.name: Invalid sign-in credentials show one generic error, without saying which field was wrong

scenarios.name: An invalid customer reference number or an invalid password are both rejected the same way

tests.test: displays an error message when signing in with invalid user id
displays an error message when signing in with invalid password
tests.notes: confirmed both tests assert the identical message text, proving the same-error claim

requirements.name: Signing out ends the session and requires signing in again to return

scenarios.name: Signing out shows a confirmation and locks the dashboard again

tests.test: allows signing out after signing in
lands on the sign in page when reopening the notification dashboard after sign out

requirements.name: No signed-in user identity is shown anywhere in the service

scenarios.name: The dashboard shows no identity for the signed-in user

tests.test: does not display the signed in user after signing in
